## PR 239

**Article model, categories, authors, publish states**

**বাংলায়:** ব্লগের লেখার কাঠামো: বাংলা বা ইংরেজি লেখা, ভাগ, লেখক, সার্চের বিবরণ; আইডিয়া থেকে লেখা, তিন ধাপের যাচাই, তারপর সময় ঠিক বা প্রকাশ; কোনো লেখা মোছা হয় না, AI লেখক সবসময় AI বলে দেখানো; শুরুতে বন্ধ

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-06
  - Build status row: article model, categories, authors, publish states (After launch, batch 9; settings `blog.journal` v222, off: 12 a page, 200/150 words a minute, at least 2 minutes, 4 products, review by another person off; migration `0147_blog_posts`; permissions `blog.read`, `blog.write`, `blog.publish`): English or Bengali articles with their own link, category, author, search description, focus keyword, one-line answer, main photo and product block; idea → writing → proofread → business facts → SEO check → scheduled or published, taken down, put away and restored (never deleted); each review pass kept; two-level categories; an AI author always shown as one; API `/api/admin/blog/{posts,categories,authors}`, audited
  - GitHub pull request #83, 6 Nov
- **What it does (original scope):** Article model, categories, authors, publish states
- **Filed under:** [S12 · Content & blog — PR 239–253](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s12--content--blog--pr-239253)

  - Routes: `/api/admin/blog/{posts,categories,authors}`
  - Settings and named keys: `blog.journal`, `blog.read`, `blog.write`, `blog.publish`
  - Names in the code: `0147_blog_posts`
- **Owning agent:** Doot
- **Links:** [Register section](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s12--content--blog--pr-239253) · Demo: screen `#/journal` in [the demo](../demo/EXTAS-demo-V12.4.html), source [`73-blog.js`](../demo/src/73-blog.js) · [README feature section](../../README.md#s12--content--blog--in-progress-2022) · [↑ PR list](#prs-in-this-stage)

## PR 591

**Blog content pipeline (owner, 19 Oct 12:10–12:14)**

**বাংলায়:** ব্লগের লেখার পাইপলাইন: আজ কতটা লেখা দরকার, কোন লেখা কোন ধাপে আটকে, কোনটা হালনাগাদ দরকার; সুস্থ থাকলে তবেই গতি বাড়ে। AI দিয়ে লেখা S15 খুললে। শুরুতে বন্ধ।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-06
  - Build status row: blog content pipeline, the non-AI part (After launch, Lane C, batch 15; registry v254 `blog.pipeline`, off; no migration): Website › Blog & journal › Content pipeline (`/admin/website/blog/pipeline`, Lumen): today's pace and why, the journal's health (share sent back in review), where every topic and article is, days ready ahead, what to write next, articles waiting for a step with their writer (never passes his own), stuck ones flagged, live articles due a refresh; while on, the calendar fills at the start pace for the ramp days, then the full pace only while healthy, always within `blog.schedule`. AI writing and proofreading wait for S15 (closed)
  - GitHub pull request #91, 6 Nov
- **What it does (original scope):** **Blog content pipeline (owner, 19 Oct 12:10–12:14)** — the blog is the main traffic engine: everyday fashion knowledge (care, washing, styling, fabrics, fit, occasions and seasons) plus our own product posts, **at least 3 and up to 5–6 posts a day**. In the backend: a topic list that Doot builds from real search demand (the owner can add topics and approve the list); Doot writes each post; **a second agent proofreads and fact-checks before it can publish** (writer never approves own post); interlinking rules (article → category/product, product → care guide, cluster links), SEO checklist, own photos, Bengali twin when ready (PR 588); a schedule that spreads posts through the day; a duplicate-topic check; per-post traffic and sales report. Quality is the system's job, not the owner's.
- **Filed under:** [S12 additions — blog as a traffic engine (owner, 19 Oct 12:10–12:22)](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s12-additions--blog-as-a-traffic-engine-owner-19-oct-12101222)
- **Updates and change notes, in date order:**
  - **19 Oct** · [Register row](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s12-additions--blog-as-a-traffic-engine-owner-19-oct-12101222): **Scope from BLOG-CONTENT-PLAN.md (19 Oct):** 8 pillars with hub pages, 179-topic bank, 90-day calendar (3/day for 2 weeks, then 5/day only while quality and indexing stay healthy — automatic drop to 3/day otherwise; an empty slot is never filled with a weak post); per-post fact sources and reviewer verdict; editorial-policy page and AI-assistance line; similarity/duplicate thresholds; required internal links + weekly unlinked-post report; care-guide link on every product page, "Shop the look" combos on style posts; refresh queue and merge tool with 301s ("updated" date only on real edits); care-lab/photo request queue; topic ideas from Search Console, support chats and site search; product blocks swap sold-out items; proofreader on a different model from the writer where possible; English/Bengali readability check; journal-assisted sales defined. **Review chain (with PR 593):** another author proofreads → Gyani checks business facts (delivery, exchange, prices) → Doot final SEO. Byline: "EXTAS Journal" with the author agent name and the expert reviewer the owner enters.
- **What was built** (from the Build status row):
  - Routes: `/admin/website/blog/pipeline`
  - Settings and named keys: `blog.pipeline`, `blog.schedule`
- **Owning agent:** Doot

## PR 592

**Blog as a complete, standard section of the shop, with our own ad placements (owner, 19 Oct 12:20)**

**বাংলায়:** জার্নালে দোকানের নিজের বিজ্ঞাপন — ব্যানার, পণ্য, সেট বা ক্যাটাগরি; কোথায় দেখাবে, কত ক্লিক আর কত অর্ডার এল; Google থেকে আসা পাঠককে পপআপ নয়। শুরুতে বন্ধ।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-06
  - Build status row: blog as a full section with our own house ads (After launch, Lane C, batch 15; registry v253 `blog.houseAds`, off; migration `0171_house_ads`): Website › Blog & journal › House ads (`/admin/website/blog/ads`, one ad at `…/ads/<id>`, Lumen): banner, product, set or category ads with words in both languages, dates and weight, each with its places (list top, topic, between cards, after paragraph N, article end, popup with trigger and cap, slim bar, sidebar); new ads and places start off, set aside never deleted; the journal picks ads by relevance within the per-page limits and never pops up on a search visitor; clicks through `/api/shop/house-ad` (nofollow sponsored, counted per place per day) and an order within the credit window credited to the place (`kpiByHouseAdPlace`). Tags, author pages, search, RSS and impression counts not built; **follow-ups (6 Nov, #92; follow-up 706):** the journal as a full section — tags with their own pages, author and reviewer pages, the journal's search and its RSS feed (registry v257, each off; migration `0172_blog_reviewer_tags`; the new pages answer "page not found" through `shopNotFound`); house ad views counted per place with the click rate on the report (registry v258 `countViews`, off; migration `0173_house_ad_views`); the House ads pages' card text at 14 px
  - GitHub pull request #92, 6 Nov
  - GitHub pull request #91, 6 Nov
- **What it does (original scope):** **Blog as a complete, standard section of the shop, with our own ad placements (owner, 19 Oct 12:20).** Blog features: categories (pillars) and sub-categories, tags, author/reviewer pages, search, archive, featured and related posts, reading time, contents, share, RSS, newsletter sign-up, Bengali twins. **House ads only (no outside ad networks):** slots on the blog home (top banner, between cards), category pages, inside the article (after paragraph N, AdSense-style), sidebar on desktop, end of article, and an optional popup per post. Each ad is our banner, product, combo or category; the owner picks which ads show in which slots, posts and categories, with dates, weights and on/off. Popups have triggers (scroll %, time, leaving) and frequency caps, are easy to close, and by default don't open the moment a phone visitor lands from Google (Google's intrusive-interstitial guidance). Click and sales report per ad and slot.
